exclusions.name: Proteomics Resource, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center
exclusions.note: In Seattle, and named almost exactly as this project's searches are worded. A publication naming it and not UWPR is not counted here.

exclusions.name: Comet
exclusions.note: An open-source sequence-database search engine that any group can download and run.

exclusions.name: SEQUEST
exclusions.note: A sequence-database search engine distributed with commercial instrument software, and used far beyond this facility.

exclusions.name: Kojak
exclusions.note: An open-source search engine for cross-linked peptides, downloaded and run by whoever needs it.

exclusions.name: Hardklor
exclusions.note: An open-source program for finding peptide isotope distributions in mass spectra, downloaded and run by whoever needs it.

exclusions.name: Limelight
exclusions.note: An open-source web application for analysing and sharing proteomics results, which any group can install on its own servers.

exclusions.name: Lorikeet
exclusions.note: An open-source viewer for annotated peptide spectra, which any site can embed in its own pages.

exclusions.name: The online peptide fragmentation calculator
exclusions.note: A public web page that works out the fragment masses of a peptide sequence.
